items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I played Frank Quintello. He was a Spanishman. Two Losing Decay. We played there.

ctx.x: Where was the Oasis? The Oasis?

I played Frank Quintello. He was a Spanishman. Two Losing Decay. We played there. I played there about two years. I was playing piano. I played piano there. I was playing from nine to three every night.
What kind of band was it? I mean... Dixieland.
